Hispānia, Hispāniae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

Often plural, Hispāniae, for the two Roman provinces (Lewis & Short). A country takes a preposition: in Hispāniam (to), in Hispāniā (in), ex Hispāniā (from).

Other words

  • Hispānus, Hispāna, Hispānum — Spanish; as a noun, a Spaniard

    also used · classical · Liv. 21.27 (Lewis & Short s.v. Hispani) · Declension on Wiktionary

See also Pyrenees, France, Europe, Madrid, Barcelona, Seville, Valencia, Catalonia, Andalusia, Ebro.
